dct_description_sm: This image presents an academic genealogy of Canadian Science Education Researchers in Canada.   Key for Individuals: - Current Canadian Science Education Researchers (Orange) - Supervisors that have been identified as Canadian Education Researchers in other disciplines (Blue) - Supervisors for which the discipline is unknown (Grey)  *Colors of the lines indicate the geographic location of the supervisor.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available without information on how it can be used. You should communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
